description: This file is a PHP script that manages test case editing, creation, versioning, and related operations within the TestLink test management system. It includes initialization procedures, handles different user actions such as creating, editing, deleting, copying test cases and steps, managing attachments, and rendering the GUI accordingly.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class that manages test case data including versioning and database interaction.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class for managing Smarty template rendering.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from HTTP request for test case operations.

methods.name: initializeOptionTransferCfg
methods.description: Creates configuration for transferring options like keywords between projects during test case creation/editing.

methods.name: createWebEditors
methods.description: Creates web editor instances configured according to layout and editor type for test case content editing.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Loads configuration settings for test case management, including editor settings and node types.

methods.name: getGrants
methods.description: Retrieves user rights and permissions relevant to test case and requirement management.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the graphical user interface data structure with permissions, URLs, and other contextual info.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering of the user interface based on current operation mode and user action, using templates.

methods.name: createNewVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a test case, updates relevant metadata, and redisplays the test case view.
